metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for semantic-memory — the unified memory-layer plugin (rebrand of semantic-sidekick at v1.0.0). One MCP server, multiple typed corpora, unified cross-corpus knowledge graph, conditional tool registration, drift detection, and human↔code translation.

plugins.name: semantic-memory
plugins.description: Unified memory-layer plugin for Claude Code. One MCP server, multiple typed corpora (vault / code / plans / docs / research / project-map), unified cross-corpus knowledge graph, conditional tool registration based on active corpora, in-process drift detection, and human↔code translation. Rebrand of semantic-sidekick at v1.0.0; existing semantic-sidekick plugins continue to work under the legacy name during the transition period.
